name: OutSystems
basis: OutSystems's own public pages and, for company basics only, the news sources named beside each fact
what: OutSystems sells a low-code development platform on which customers build applications and, through Agent Workbench, AI agents that call tools, other agents and enterprise systems.

facts.fact: Founded in 2001 by Paulo Rosado in Lisbon, Portugal (Wikipedia).
facts.span: OutSystems was founded in 2001 by Paulo Rosado in Lisbon, Portugal.

facts.fact: The company page dates the company to 2001.
Woodson Martin was appointed CEO in 2025; Paulo Rosado became chairman (Wikipedia).
facts.span: In 2025, OutSystems appointed Woodson Martin as CEO

facts.fact: The offices page lists an office in Linda-a-Velha, Portugal.
Agent Workbench was announced generally available on 30 September 2025, at the OutSystems ONE conference.
facts.span: OutSystems Announces General Availability of Agent Workbench

facts.fact: The trust page lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and ISO 22301 among its audited controls and credentials.
facts.span: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 22301

facts.fact: The New Stack (technology news) reported the Agent Workbench launch on 30 September 2025.
facts.span: OutSystems Launches a Low-Code Workbench for Building Enterprise AI Agents

people.name: Paulo Rosado
people.role: Founder and Chairman of the Board

solutions.name: OutSystems Agent Workbench
solutions.what: Builds, runs and governs AI agents (agentic apps) on OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC): agents call server actions, MCP tools and external A2A agents, with guardrails, evaluations, traces and workflow human-in-the-loop steps.
solutions.status: generally available since 30 September 2025 (vendor news release); the scout's name 'Agentic AI Workbench' is the URL slug, the product page and docs say 'Agent Workbench'

solutions.name: Mentor
solutions.what: AI-assisted app generation and modification inside ODC (Mentor Web and Mentor Studio), part of Agentic Systems Engineering.

solutions.name: OutSystems Agent Experience (OutSystems MCP)
solutions.what: Opens the OutSystems platform to external AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Kiro) through an MCP server, to build and deploy apps.
solutions.status: generally available, announced 7 October 2026 (vendor news release)

solutions.name: OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC) and OutSystems 11
solutions.what: The underlying low-code application platforms (cloud-native ODC and the earlier O11).

stories.what: Built an AI Studio of custom agents; its Customer Support Agent auto-classifies and routes support tickets; the company expects 20% of incidents to be resolved automatically (an expectation, not a measured figure).
Early access participant; a content classification agent routes customer service enquiries.
stories.span: implemented a content classification agent that intelligently routes customer service enquiries

stories.what: Early access participant; built a log analysis agent that interprets error logs and recommends actions, and automated document mapping.
stories.span: built an intelligent log analysis agent to interpret error logs

stories.what: Early access participant; built a Customer Escalation Agent that interprets unstructured customer interaction data.
stories.span: built an intelligent Customer Escalation Agent

stories.what: Working to deploy agents that analyse property evaluation reports and suggest deviations during loan origination (in progress, per the release).
stories.span: is working to deploy Agent Workbench to improve the accuracy of loan underwriting
